[Science](https://www.asiae.co.kr/en/list/science) # 'AI Unicorn' Upstage to Receive Investment from NVIDIA by _Lee Myeonghwan_ Published 09 Nov.2026 17:21(KST) Share Language Text Size [Print](https://www.asiae.co.kr/lang/print.htm?idxno=2026110917214541113&lang=en "Print") ## Set to secure NVIDIA investment in second tranche of Series C round Attracting investment from global tech giants, following Amazon and AMD Funds to be used to enhance in-house models and recruit talent Upstage, the first generative artificial intelligence (AI) company in Korea to join the ranks of unicorns, will receive an investment from NVIDIA. The company plans to use the funds to enhance its in-house AI models and attract talent. Upstage said on Nov. 9 that it is set to receive an investment from NVIDIA in the ongoing second tranche of its Series C funding round. It did not disclose the expected investment amount. [![Upstage logo. Upstage](https://cphoto.asiae.co.kr/listimglink/1/2026110917152092507_1794212121.png)](https://www.asiae.co.kr/news/img_view.htm?img=2026110917152092507_1794212121.png "Upstage logo. Upstage") Upstage logo. Upstage [View original image](https://www.asiae.co.kr/news/img_view.htm?img=2026110917152092507_1794212121.png "Upstage logo. Upstage") Once the investment is completed, Upstage will count global technology companies Amazon, AMD and NVIDIA among its investors. In the first tranche of its Series C round, which closed in April, Upstage was valued at more than 1 trillion won, joining the ranks of unicorns. Upstage is also proving its competitiveness in the global model market. Its latest in-house large language models (LLMs), Solar Pro 4 and Solar Mini 4, became the first Korean models to rank among the top models on the global developer platform OpenRouter based on token usage for closed models. Upstage plans to expand its presence in overseas markets with models that combine strong performance and cost efficiency. It will use the funds raised through its Series C round to enhance its in-house AI models, including Solar; recruit key talent in Korea and abroad; and expand its push into overseas markets such as the United States and Japan. ### Hot Picks Today [!["Two Spend 500,000 Won in a Flash, Yet Wait Two Hours?" ...
